articles.title_en: On the Optimal Design of a Financial Stability Fund
articles.title_cn: 金融稳定基金的优化设计
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of a Financial Stability Fund (the “Fund” henceforth) for a union of sovereign countries. By design, the contract prevents country defaults, as well as undesired expected losses, which in a union translate into excessive risk mutualizations. A participant country has greater ability to borrow and share risks than using sovereign debt financing. The Fund contract also provides better incentives for the country to reduce endogenous risks. These efficiency gains arise from the ability of the Fund to offer long-term contingent financial contracts, subject to limited enforcement and moral hazard constraints. We develop the theory and quantitatively compare the constrained-efficient Fund economy with an incomplete markets economy with default. We calibrate our economy to the euro area “stressed countries” in the debt crisis (2010–2). Substantial welfare gains are achieved, particularly in times of crisis. The Fund is, in fact, a risk-sharing, crisis prevention and resolution mechanism, which transforms the participant countries’ defaultable sovereign debt into the union’s safe assets. In sum, our theory can help to improve current official lending practices and, for example, to eventually design a European Fiscal Fund.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为主权国家联盟开发了金融稳定基金（以下简称“基金”）模型。通过设计，该合同可以防止国家违约以及意外的预期损失，这些损失在联盟中会转化为过度的风险共同化。与使用主权债务融资相比，参与国有更大的借贷和分担风险的能力。基金合同还为国家降低内生风险提供了更好的激励。这些效率收益源于基金组织提供长期或有财务合同的能力，但受到有限的执行和道德风险约束。我们发展了该理论，并定量比较了受限效率基金经济与带有违约的不完全市场经济。我们根据欧元区债务危机中的“压力国家”来调整我们的经济（2010-2）。实现了可观的福利收益，特别是在危机时期。该基金实际上是一种风险分担、危机预防和解决机制，将参与国的可违约主权债务转化为联盟的安全资产。总之，我们的理论可以帮助改善当前的官方贷款实践，例如最终设计欧洲财政基金。

articles.title_en: Temporal-Difference Estimation of Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
articles.title_cn: 动态离散选择模型的时差估计
articles.abstract_en: We study the use of Temporal-Difference learning for estimating the structural parameters in dynamic discrete choice models. Our algorithms are based on the conditional choice probability approach but use functional approximations to estimate various terms in the pseudo-log-likelihood function. We suggest two approaches: The first—linear semi-gradient—provides approximations to the recursive terms using basis functions. The second—Approximate Value Iteration—builds a sequence of approximations to the recursive terms by solving non-parametric estimation problems. Our approaches are fast and naturally allow for continuous and/or high-dimensional state spaces. Furthermore, they do not require specification of transition densities. In dynamic games, they avoid integrating over other players’ actions, further heightening the computational advantage. Our proposals can be paired with popular existing methods such as pseudo-maximum-likelihood, and we propose locally robust corrections for the latter to achieve parametric rates of convergence. Monte Carlo simulations confirm the properties of our algorithms in practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究使用时间差分学习来估计动态离散选择模型中的结构参数。我们的算法基于条件选择概率方法，但使用函数近似来估计伪对数似然函数中的各项。我们建议使用 二 方法：第一（线性半梯度）使用基函数提供递归项的近似值。 第二——近似值迭代——通过解决非参数估计问题来构建递归项的近似序列。我们的方法快速且自然地允许连续和/或高维状态空间。此外，它们不需要指定过渡密度。在动态游戏中，他们避免整合其他玩家的动作，从而进一步提高计算优势。我们的建议可以与流行的现有方法（例如伪最大似然法）配对，并且我们为后者提出局部鲁棒校正以实现参数收敛率。蒙特卡洛模拟在实践中证实了我们算法的特性。

articles.title_en: Demand Analysis under Latent Choice Constraints
articles.title_cn: 潜在选择约束下的需求分析
articles.abstract_en: Consumer choices are constrained in many markets due to either supply-side rationing or information frictions. Examples include matching markets for schools and colleges; entry-level labour markets; limited brand awareness and inattention in consumer markets; and selective admissions to healthcare services. We analyse a general random utility model for consumer preferences that allows for endogenous characteristics and a reduced-form choice-set formation rule that can be derived from models of the examples described above. We show non-parametric identification of this model, propose an estimator, and apply these methods to study admissions in the market for kidney dialysis in California. Our identification results require two sets of instruments, one that only affects consumer preferences and the other that only affects choice sets. We show that both instruments are necessary for identification. These results also suggest tests of choice-set constraints, which we apply to the dialysis market. We find that dialysis facilities are less likely to admit new patients when they have a higher-than-normal caseload and that patients are more likely to travel further when nearby facilities have high caseloads. Finally, we estimate consumers’ preferences and facilities’ rationing rules using a Gibbs sampler.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于供应方配给或信息摩擦，许多市场的消费者选择受到限制。例子包括学校和学院的匹配市场；入门级劳动力市场；消费者市场的品牌认知度有限且注意力不集中；以及选择性地接受医疗服务。我们分析了消费者偏好的一般随机效用模型，该模型考虑了内生特征和可以从上述示例的模型中导出的简化形式的选择集形成规则。我们展示了该模型的非参数识别，提出了一个估计器，并将这些方法应用于研究加利福尼亚州肾透析市场的入院情况。我们的识别结果需要二组工具，一只影响消费者偏好，另一组只影响选择组。我们证明这两种工具都是识别所必需的。这些结果还建议对选择集约束进行测试，我们将其应用于透析市场。我们发现，当透析设施的病例量高于正常水平时，透析设施不太可能接纳新患者，而当附近设施的病例量较高时，患者更有可能前往更远的地方。最后，我们使用吉布斯抽样器估计消费者的偏好和设施的配给规则。

articles.title_en: Algorithmic Recommendations and Human Discretion
articles.title_cn: 算法建议和人类自由裁量权
articles.abstract_en: Human decision-makers frequently override the recommendations generated by predictive algorithms, but it is unclear whether these discretionary overrides add valuable private information or reintroduce human biases and mistakes. We develop new quasi-experimental tools to measure the impact of human discretion over an algorithm on the accuracy of decisions, even when the outcome of interest is only selectively observed, in the context of bail decisions. We find that 90% of the judges in our setting underperform the algorithm when they make a discretionary override, with most making override decisions that are no better than random. Yet the remaining 10% of judges outperform the algorithm in terms of both accuracy and fairness when they make a discretionary override. We provide suggestive evidence on the behaviour underlying these differences in judge performance, showing that the high-performing judges are more likely to use relevant private information and are less likely to overreact to highly salient events compared to the low-performing judges.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类决策者经常推翻预测算法生成的建议，但尚不清楚这些酌情推翻是否会增加有价值的私人信息或重新引入人类偏见和错误。我们开发了新的准实验工具来衡量人类自由裁量权对算法对决策准确性的影响，即使在保释决定的背景下，即使只是选择性地观察感兴趣的结果。我们发现，在我们的设置中，90% 的法官在做出酌情覆盖时，算法表现不佳，大多数人做出的覆盖决定并不比随机决定更好。然而，剩下的 10% 法官在做出酌情推翻时，在准确性和公平性方面都优于算法。我们提供了关于法官表现差异背后的行为的暗示性证据，表明与表现不佳的法官相比，表现出色的法官更有可能使用相关的私人信息，并且不太可能对高度显着的事件反应过度。

articles.title_en: The Surrogate Index: Combining Short-Term Proxies to Estimate Long-Term Treatment Effects More Rapidly and Precisely
articles.title_cn: 替代指数：结合短期替代指标来更快速、更准确地估计长期治疗效果
articles.abstract_en: A common challenge in estimating the impact of interventions (e.g. job training programmes, educational programmes) is that many outcomes of interest (e.g. lifetime earnings or other labour market outcomes) are observed with a long delay. In biomedical settings, this is often addressed by using short-term outcomes as so-called “surrogates” for the outcome of interest, e.g. tumour size as a surrogate for mortality in cancer studies. We build on this literature by combining multiple, possibly qualitatively distinct, short-term outcomes (e.g. short-run earnings and employment indicators) systematically into a “surrogate index”. Under the Prentice surrogacy assumption, which requires that the primary outcome is independent of the treatment conditional on the surrogates, we show that the average treatment effect on the surrogate index equals the treatment effect on the long-term outcome. We also relate the surrogacy assumption to a set of structural, causal assumptions. We then characterize the bias that arises from violations of each of the key assumptions, and we provide simple methods to validate these assumptions using additional observed outcomes. We apply our method to analyse the long-term impacts of a multi-site job training experiment in California. Rather than waiting a full 9 years to directly observe the long-term impact, we show that it is possible to use short-term (the first six quarters) outcomes as surrogates. Given the surrogacy assumption one could have estimated the programme’s long-term impacts on mean employment rates using the employment rates observed in the first six quarters, with a 35% reduction in standard errors relative to a simple difference in means estimator based on all 9 years of data.
articles.abstract_cn: 估计干预措施（例如职业培训计划、教育计划）影响的一个常见挑战是，许多感兴趣的结果（例如终生收入或其他劳动力市场结果）的观察有很长的延迟。在生物医学环境中，通常通过使用短期结果作为感兴趣结果的所谓“替代品”来解决这个问题，例如在癌症研究中将肿瘤大小作为死亡率的替代指标。我们在此文献的基础上，将多种可能在质量上不同的短期结果（例如短期收入和就业指标）系统地组合成“替代指数”。在 Prentice 替代假设下，该假设要求主要结果独立于替代者的治疗条件，我们表明替代指数的平均治疗效果等于长期结果的治疗效果。我们还将代孕假设与一组结构性、因果性假设联系起来。然后，我们描述了因违反每个关键假设而产生的偏差，并提供简单的方法来使用额外的观察结果来验证这些假设。我们应用我们的方法来分析加利福尼亚州多地点职业培训实验的长期影响。我们证明可以使用短期（第一六个季度）结果作为替代，而不是等待整整9年来直接观察长期影响。鉴于替代假设一可以使用第一六个季度观察到的就业率来估计该计划对平均就业率的长期影响，相对于基于所有35%年数据的均值估计器的简单差异，标准误差减少9。

articles.title_en: Demand Stimulus as Social Policy
articles.title_cn: 作为社会政策的需求刺激
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a panel of city-level data with rich demographic information to estimate the distributional effects of Department of Defense spending and its effects on a range of social outcomes. The income and employment generated by defence spending accrue predominantly to households without a bachelor's degree. These households as well as Black and Hispanic households tend to disproportionately benefit from this spending. Defence spending also promotes a range of beneficial social outcomes that are often targeted by government programs, including reductions in poverty, divorce rates, disability rates, and mortality rates, as well as increases in homeownership rates, health insurance rates, and occupational prestige. We compare the effects of defence spending with the effects of general demand shocks and explore reasons for the differential effects of the shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用包含丰富人口统计信息的城市级数据来估计国防部支出的分配效应及其对一系列社会结果的影响。国防开支产生的收入和就业主要集中在没有学士学位的家庭。这些家庭以及黑人和西班牙裔家庭往往从这项支出中受益匪浅。国防支出还可以促进一系列有益的社会成果，这些成果通常是政府计划的目标，包括减少贫困、离婚率、残疾率和死亡率，以及提高住房拥有率、医疗保险率和职业声望。我们将国防支出的影响与一般需求冲击的影响进行比较，并探讨冲击产生不同影响的原因。

articles.title_en: The Origins and Control of Forest Fires in the Tropics
articles.title_cn: 热带森林火灾的起源与控制
articles.abstract_en: Environmental externalities—uncompensated damages imposed on others—lie at the root of climate change, pollution, deforestation and biodiversity loss. Empirical evidence is limited, however, as to how externalities drive private decision making. We study one such behaviour, illegal tropical forest fires, using 15 years of daily satellite data covering over 107,000 fires across Indonesia. Weather-induced variation in fire spread risk and variation in who owns surrounding land allow us to identify how far externalities influence the decision to use fire. Relative to when all spread risks are internalized, we find that firms overuse fire when surrounded by unleased government lands where property rights are weak. In contrast, and consistent with the Coase Theorem, firms treat risks to nearby private concessions similarly to risks to their own land. Government sanctions, concentrated on fires spreading to populated areas, also deter fires, consistent with Pigouvian deterrence.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境外部性——对他人造成的无偿损害——是气候变化、污染、森林砍伐和生物多样性丧失的根源。然而，关于外部性如何推动私人决策的经验证据有限。我们使用15年涵盖印度尼西亚各地超过107,000起火灾的每日卫星数据来研究一此类行为，即非法热带森林火灾。天气引起的火灾蔓延风险的变化以及周围土地所有者的变化使我们能够确定外部因素对用火决策的影响程度。相对于所有分散风险都内部化的情况，我们发现，当企业被产权薄弱的未出租政府土地包围时，企业会过度使用火。相比之下，与科斯定理一致，企业对待附近私人特许权的风险与对待自己土地的风险类似。政府制裁主要针对蔓延到人口稠密地区的火灾，也能阻止火灾，这与庇古威慑相一致。

articles.title_en: Repurchase Options in the Market for Lemons
articles.abstract_en: We study repurchase options (repo contracts) in a competitive asset market with adverse selection. Gains from trade emerge from a liquidity need, but private information about asset quality prevents the full realization of trades. In equilibrium, a single repo contract pools all assets. The embedded repurchase option mitigates adverse selection by improving the volume of trades relative to outright sales. However, liquidity provision can be inefficiently low as lenders compete to attract high-quality assets via high haircuts and low rates. The equilibrium has a closed form and aligns well with empirical patterns across Mortgage-Backed Securities repos.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究逆向竞争的资产市场中的回购期权（回购合约）。交易收益源于流动性需求，但有关资产质量的私人信息阻碍了交易的全面实现。在均衡状态下，单个回购合约汇集了所有资产。嵌入式回购期权通过提高相对于直接销售的交易量来减轻逆向选择。然而，由于贷款机构通过高折扣和低利率竞相吸引优质资产，流动性供应可能效率低下。该均衡具有封闭形式，并且与抵押贷款支持证券回购的经验模式非常吻合。

articles.title_en: What Do Policies Value?
articles.abstract_en: When a policy prioritizes one person over another, is it because they benefit more, or because they are preferred? This paper develops a method to uncover the values consistent with observed allocation decisions. We estimate how much each person benefits from an intervention, and then reconcile the allocation with (i) the welfare weights assigned to different people; (ii) heterogeneous treatment effects of the intervention; and (iii) weights on different outcomes. We demonstrate this approach by analyzing Mexico’s PROGRESA anti-poverty programme. The analysis reveals that while the programme prioritized certain subgroups—such as indigenous households—the fact that those groups benefited more implies that the programme did not actually assign them a higher welfare weight. We also find evidence that the policy valued outcomes differently from households. The PROGRESA case illustrates how the method makes it possible to audit existing policies, and to design future policies that better align with values.
articles.abstract_cn: 当一项政策将一个人优先于另一个人时，是因为他们受益更多，还是因为他们受到优先考虑？本文开发了一种方法来揭示与观察到的分配决策一致的值。我们估计每个人从干预中受益多少，然后将分配与（i）分配给不同人的福利权重进行协调； (ii) 干预措施的异质治疗效果； (iii) 不同结果的权重。我们通过分析墨西哥的 PROGRESA 反贫困计划来展示这种方法。分析显示，虽然该计划优先考虑某些亚群体（例如土著家庭），但这些群体受益更多的事实意味着该计划实际上并未为他们分配更高的福利权重。我们还发现有证据表明该政策对结果的重视程度与家庭不同。 PROGRESA 案例说明了该方法如何能够审核现有政策并设计更符合价值观的未来政策。

articles.title_en: Contract Terms, Employment Shocks, and Default in Credit Cards
articles.abstract_en: Regulatory concerns over a tension between expanding financial access and limiting default have led to significant restrictions on contract terms in a number of countries, despite limited evidence on their effectiveness. We use a large nation-wide RCT to examine new borrower responses to changes in interest rates and minimum payments for a credit card that accounted for 15% of all first-time formal loans in Mexico. Default rates were 19% over the 26 month experiment and a 30 pp decrease in interest rates decreased default by 2.5 pp with no effects on the newest borrowers. Doubling minimum payments increased default by 0.8 pp during the experiment but reduced it by 1 pp afterwards, possibly by reducing debt. Matching the experimental sample to their formal employment histories we find that the effect of job separation—more common among new borrowers—on default is seven times larger than the effect of the 30 pp interest rate change. We provide a simple framework for interpreting the experimental results, and rationalize the smaller contract term effects by their limited effects on cash flow rather than by differences in per-peso impacts.

articles.title_en: Structural Change, Land Use and Urban Expansion
articles.title_cn: 结构变化、土地利用和城市扩张
articles.abstract_en: How do cities grow in the process of structural transformation? To answer this question, we develop a multi-sector spatial equilibrium model with endogenous land use: land is used either for agriculture or housing. Urban land, densely populated due to commuting frictions, expands out of agricultural land. With low productivity and high subsistence needs, farmland is expensive, households cannot afford large homes and cities are very dense. Increasing productivity reallocates factors away from agriculture, freeing up land for urban expansion and limiting the increase in land values despite higher income and urban population. With the area of cities growing faster than urban population, urban density can persistently decline, as in the data over a long period. The quantitative evaluation calibrated to historical data assembled for France over 180 years explains a large fraction of the joint evolution of urban areas, population density and land values across time and space.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市如何在结构转型过程中成长？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一个具有内生土地利用的多部门空间均衡模型：土地要么用于农业，要么用于住房。由于通勤摩擦，人口稠密的城市土地从农业用地中扩展出来。由于生产力低下和生存需求高，农田价格昂贵，家庭买不起大房子，城市也非常密集。尽管收入和城市人口增加，但生产率的提高将要素从农业中重新分配出去，为城市扩张腾出了土地，并限制了土地价值的增长。随着城市面积的增长速度快于城市人口的增长速度，城市密度可能会持续下降，正如长期数据所示。根据法国180年收集的历史数据进行的定量评估解释了城市地区、人口密度和土地价值随时间和空间的联合演变的很大一部分。

articles.title_en: What’s My Employee Worth? The Effects of Salary Benchmarking
articles.title_cn: 我的员工值多少钱？薪资基准的影响
articles.abstract_en: Firms are allowed to use aggregate data on market salaries to set pay, a practice known as salary benchmarking. Using national payroll data, we study firms that gain access to a tool that reveals market benchmarks for each job title. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the benchmark information reduces salary dispersion by 25%. Thus, salary dispersion must stem partly from aggregate uncertainty about the salaries offered by other firms. Our model formalizes how salary dispersion can arise even in competitive labour markets for identical workers when such uncertainty exists, and we discuss implications for an ongoing policy debate.
articles.abstract_cn: 公司可以使用市场薪资的汇总数据来设定薪资，这种做法称为薪资基准。利用全国薪资数据，我们研究了那些能够使用揭示每个职位的市场基准的工具的公司。使用双重差异设计，我们发现基准信息将薪资离散度降低了25%。因此，薪资分散一定部分源于其他公司提供的薪资的总体不确定性。我们的模型正式阐述了即使在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中，当存在这种不确定性时，相同工人的薪资差异也会如何出现，并且我们讨论了对正在进行的政策辩论的影响。

articles.title_en: Normalizations and Misspecification in Skill Formation Models
articles.title_cn: 技能形成模型的规范化和错误指定
articles.abstract_en: An important class of structural models studies the determinants of skill formation and the optimal timing of interventions. In this article, I provide new identification results for these models and investigate the effects of seemingly innocuous scale and location restrictions on parameters of interest. To do so, I first characterize the identified set of all parameters without these additional restrictions and show that important policy-relevant parameters are point identified under weaker assumptions than commonly used in the literature. The implications of imposing standard scale and location restrictions depend on how the model is specified, but they generally impact the interpretation of parameters and may affect counterfactuals. Importantly, with the popular constant elasticity of substitution (CES) production function, commonly used scale restrictions fix identified parameters and lead to misspecification. Consequently, simply changing the units of measurements of observed variables might yield ineffective investment strategies and misleading policy recommendations. I show how existing estimators can easily be adapted to solve these issues. As a byproduct, this article also presents a general and formal definition of when restrictions are truly normalizations.
articles.abstract_cn: 一类重要的结构模型研究技能形成的决定因素和干预的最佳时机。在本文中，我为这些模型提供了新的识别结果，并研究了看似无害的规模和位置限制对感兴趣参数的影响。为此，我第一在没有这些额外限制的情况下描述了所有参数的确定集，并表明重要的政策相关参数是在比文献中常用的假设更弱的假设下确定的。施加标准规模和位置限制的影响取决于模型的指定方式，但它们通常会影响参数的解释，并可能影响反事实。重要的是，随着流行的恒定替代弹性（CES）生产函数，常用的规模限制固定了已确定的参数并导致错误指定。因此，简单地改变观察变量的计量单位可能会产生无效的投资策略和误导性的政策建议。我展示了如何轻松地调整现有的估算器来解决这些问题。作为副产品，本文还提出了限制何时真正正常化的一般且正式的定义。

articles.title_en: To Own or to Rent? The Effects of Transaction Taxes on Housing Markets
articles.title_cn: 拥有还是租赁？交易税对房地产市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: Using sales and leasing data, this paper finds three novel effects of a higher property transaction tax: higher buy-to-rent transactions alongside lower buy-to-own transactions despite both being taxed, a lower sales-to-leases ratio, and a lower price-to-rent ratio. This paper explains these facts by developing a search model with entry of investors and households, households choosing to own or rent in the presence of credit frictions, and homeowners deciding when to move house. A higher transaction tax reduces homeowners’ mobility and increases demand for rental properties, which explains the empirical facts and leads to a lower homeownership rate. The deadweight loss is large at 111% of tax revenue, with more than half of this due to distorting decisions to own or rent.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用销售和租赁数据，本文发现三较高的房产交易税带来的新影响：尽管均征税，但买房出租交易增加，而买房自有交易减少，销售与租赁比率较低，房价与租金比率较低。本文通过开发一个搜索模型来解释这些事实，其中包括投资者和家庭、在存在信用摩擦的情况下选择拥有或租赁的家庭以及决定何时搬家的房主。较高的交易税会降低房主的流动性并增加对租赁房产的需求，这解释了经验事实并导致较低的住房拥有率。无谓损失占税收收入的111%很大，其中一半以上是由于扭曲的拥有或租赁决策造成的。

articles.title_en: Slum Upgrading and Long-Run Urban Development: Evidence from Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 贫民窟改造和长期城市发展：来自印度尼西亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: Developing countries face massive urbanization and slum upgrading is a popular policy to improve shelter for many. Yet, preserving slums at the expense of formal developments can raise concerns of misallocation of land. We estimate causal, long-term impacts of the 1969–84 KIP programme, which provided basic upgrades to 5 million residents covering 25% of land in Jakarta, Indonesia. We assemble high-resolution data on programme boundaries and 2015 outcomes and address programme selection bias through localized comparisons. On average, KIP areas today have lower land values, shorter buildings, and are more informal, per a photographs-based slum index. The negative effects are concentrated within 5 km of the CBD. We develop a spatial equilibrium model to characterize the welfare implications of KIP. Counterfactuals suggest that 79% of the welfare effects stem from removing KIP in the centre and highlight how to mitigate losses to displaced residents.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家面临大规模城市化，贫民窟改造是改善许多人住房状况的一项流行政策。然而，以牺牲正式开发为代价来保护贫民窟可能会引起对土地分配不当的担忧。我们估计了 1969-84 KIP 计划的因果长期影响，该计划为覆盖印度尼西亚雅加达 5 土地的 25% 百万 居民提供了基本升级。我们收集有关项目边界和2015结果的高分辨率数据，并通过局部比较解决项目选择偏差。根据基于照片的贫民窟指数，平均而言，如今的 KIP 地区土地价值较低，建筑物较短，而且更加非正式。负面影响集中在CBD 5公里范围内。我们开发了一个空间均衡模型来描述 KIP 的福利影响。反事实表明，79% 的福利效应源于移除中心的 KIP，并强调如何减轻流离失所居民的损失。

articles.title_en: Sanctions and the Exchange Rate
articles.abstract_en: Trade wars and financial sanctions are again becoming an increasingly common part of the international economic landscape, and the dynamics of the exchange rate are often used in real time to evaluate the effectiveness of sanctions and policy responses. We show that sanctions limiting a country’s exports or freezing its assets depreciate the exchange rate, while sanctions limiting imports appreciate it, even when both types of policies have exactly the same effect on real allocations, including household welfare and government fiscal revenues. Beyond the direct effect from sanctions, increased precautionary savings in foreign currency also depreciate the exchange rate when they are not offset by the sale of official reserves or financial repression of foreign-currency savings. We show that the dynamics of the ruble exchange rate following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 are quantitatively consistent with the combined effects of these forces calibrated to the observed sanctions and government policies. We evaluate the associated welfare, fiscal and inflationary consequences for both Russia and the coalition of Western countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易战和金融制裁再次成为国际经济格局中越来越常见的一部分，汇率动态经常被用来实时评估制裁和政策反应的有效性。我们表明，限制一国出口或冻结其资产的制裁会使汇率贬值，而限制进口的制裁则会使汇率升值，即使这两种政策对实际分配（包括家庭福利和政府财政收入）具有完全相同的影响。除了制裁的直接影响之外，外币预防性储蓄的增加，如果不能通过出售官方储备或外币储蓄的金融抑制来抵消，也会导致汇率贬值。我们表明，二月2022俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后卢布汇率的动态在数量上与根据观察到的制裁和政府政策校准的这些力量的综合影响一致。我们评估了俄罗斯和西方国家联盟的相关福利、财政和通货膨胀后果。

articles.title_en: Taxes Depress Corporate Borrowing: Evidence from Private Firms
articles.title_cn: 税收抑制企业借贷：来自私营企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use variation in state corporate income tax rates to re-examine the relation between taxes and corporate leverage. Contrary to prior research, corporate leverage rises after tax cuts for small private firms. An estimated dynamic equilibrium model shows that tax cuts make capital more productive and spur the use of leverage. Tax cuts also produce more distant default thresholds and lower credit spreads. These effects outweigh the lower interest tax deduction and lead to higher optimal leverage choices, especially for firms with flexible investment policies. The presence of the interest tax deduction raises consumer welfare in equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用州企业所得税税率的变化来重新审视税收与企业杠杆之间的关系。与之前的研究相反，小型私营企业减税后企业杠杆率上升。估计的动态均衡模型表明，减税可以提高资本的生产率并刺激杠杆的使用。减税还带来了更遥远的违约门槛和更低的信用利差。这些影响超过了较低的利息税减免，并导致更高的最优杠杆选择，特别是对于投资政策灵活的公司而言。利息税减免的存在提高了消费者的均衡福利。

articles.title_en: Supply Chain Disruption and Reorganization: Theory and Evidence From Ukraine’s War
articles.title_cn: 供应链中断与重组：乌克兰战争的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: How do localized conflicts disrupt supply chains and prompt firms to reorganize them? How do these forces affect firm-level and aggregate economic activity? Using firm-to-firm Ukrainian railway-shipment data before and during the 2014 Russia–Ukraine conflict, we document that firms with prior supplier and buyer exposure to the conflict areas substantially decreased their output. Simultaneously, firms reorganized their production linkages away from partners directly or indirectly exposed to the conflict shock. We build a general-equilibrium production-network model with endogeneous link formation, and we show that our model’s sufficient statistics accurately explains the observed relative decline in firm output once we account for network reorganization. Calibrating our model to the Ukrainian economy, we find that the localized conflict decreased aggregate output in nonconflict areas by 5.5%. This effect increases to 8.4% if we abstract from endogeneous link formation, suggesting that production-network reorganization partially mitigates the detrimental, far-reaching aggregate economic costs of conflicts.
articles.abstract_cn: 局部冲突如何扰乱供应链并促使企业重组供应链？这些力量如何影响企业层面和总体经济活动？使用2014俄罗斯-乌克兰冲突之前和期间的企业间乌克兰铁路运输数据，我们记录了先前供应商和买家接触过冲突地区的企业大幅减少了产量。与此同时，企业重组了生产联系，远离直接或间接遭受冲突冲击的合作伙伴。我们建立了一个具有内生链接形成的一般均衡生产网络模型，并且我们表明，一旦我们考虑了网络重组，我们的模型的充分统计数据就可以准确地解释所观察到的企业产出的相对下降。根据乌克兰经济校准我们的模型，我们发现局部冲突使非冲突地区的总产出下降了 5.5%。如果我们从内生联系的形成中抽象出来，这种效应会增加到8.4%，这表明生产网络重组部分减轻了冲突造成的有害的、影响深远的总经济成本。

articles.title_en: All Along the Watchtower: Military Landholders and Serfdom Consolidation in Early Modern Russia
articles.title_cn: 一直在瞭望塔：近代早期俄罗斯的军事土地所有者和农奴制巩固
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the emergence of coercive labour institutions using the case of serfdom in early modern Russia. We argue that serfdom consolidated under the pressure of landholding military elites who gained political influence due to the prolonged struggle with steppe nomads. To contain nomadic raids, the Russian state erected defence lines on the southern frontier, and granted land in the area to soldiers in charge of its defence. The soldiers could not farm while on defence duty, nor could they compete in the market for peasant labour, as the land had been selected for its defensive rather than agricultural value. The system was therefore only sustainable by restricting labour mobility. In response to the volume of landholders’ collective petitions, the Russian state gradually tied peasants to the land and institutionalized serfdom in the written law. Using newly digitized population data from the 17th century, we show a higher prevalence of serfs and military landholders in districts on the defence line. We also find a higher prevalence of small estates—up to 25 serf households—sufficient to support a soldier and his family. Placebo tests show that these patterns do not hold for non-serf peasants, or for merchants and artisans. To ensure causality, we develop a novel algorithm that reconstructs the optimal invasion routes for nomads and pinpoints the optimal location of the defence line using topographic data. Our results highlight the primacy of political economy factors over purely economic ones, such as the land–labour ratio or the grain trade, in the development of serfdom. This sheds new light on the possible mechanisms of institutional divergence between Eastern and Western Europe in the early modern period.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文以近代早期俄罗斯农奴制为例，考察了强制劳动制度的出现。我们认为，农奴制是在拥有土地的军事精英的压力下得到巩固的，这些精英由于与草原游牧民族的长期斗争而获得了政治影响力。为了遏制游牧民族的袭击，俄罗斯政府在南部边境设立了防线，并将该地区的土地授予负责防御的士兵。士兵们在执行国防任务时不能耕种，也不能在农民劳动力市场上竞争，因为选择土地是为了防御而非农业价值。因此，该体系只有通过限制劳动力流动才能维持。为了应对大量土地所有者的集体请愿，俄罗斯国家逐渐将农民与土地捆绑在一起，并通过成文法将农奴制制度化。使用17世纪新的数字化人口数据，我们发现防线地区农奴和军事土地所有者的比例较高。我们还发现小庄园的普遍存在——最多25个农奴家庭——足以养活一名士兵及其家人。安慰剂测试表明，这些模式不适用于非农奴农民、商人和工匠。为了确保因果关系，我们开发了一种新颖的算法，可以重建游牧民族的最佳入侵路线，并使用地形数据确定防线的最佳位置。我们的研究结果强调了在农奴制发展过程中，政治经济因素相对于土地-劳动力比率或粮食贸易等纯粹经济因素的重要性。这为近代早期东欧和西欧之间制度分歧的可能机制提供了新的线索。

articles.title_en: Patents, News, and Business Cycles
articles.abstract_en: We exploit information in patent applications to construct an instrumental variable for the identification of technology news shocks that relaxes all the identifying assumptions traditionally used in the literature. The instrument recovers news shocks that have no effect on aggregate productivity in the short-run, but are a significant driver of its trend component. The shock prompts a broad-based expansion in anticipation of the future increase in total factor productivity (TFP), with output, consumption, and investment all rising well before any material increase in TFP is recorded. Despite the positive conditional comovements, the shock only accounts for a modest share of fluctuations of macroeconomic aggregates at business cycle frequencies. Financial markets price-in news shocks on impact, while most of the macro aggregates respond with some delay.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用专利申请中的信息构建一个工具变量来识别技术新闻冲击，从而放松了文献中传统上使用的所有识别假设。该工具恢复了新闻冲击，这些冲击在短期内对总体生产率没有影响，但却是其趋势成分的重要驱动力。这种冲击促使人们对未来全要素生产率（TFP）增长的预期出现广泛的扩张，在 TFP 出现任何实质性增长之前，产出、消费和投资都在增长。尽管存在积极的条件联动，但冲击仅占商业周期频率宏观经济总量波动的一小部分。金融市场价格受到消息冲击，而大多数宏观总量的反应则有所延迟。
